verdict.rationale: The docs show a dashboard-free path. A curl one-liner starts Elasticsearch locally (elastic-docs-5, elastic-docs-17), official language clients cover indexing and search (elastic-docs-6, elastic-docs-40), and creating an index mapping is enough to start ingesting and querying (elastic-docs-23). An official MCP server exists (elastic-docs-28, elastic-probe-4), and official skills teach coding agents to work with the stack (elastic-docs-10). missing for 10: documentation of which MCP tools cover index creation and writes versus read-only queries; a non-console path for provisioning a serverless project after trial signup; a discoverable llms.txt or OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404); independent hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the full flow.
